svg.text: LT14-M01 · Motor carrier and supported shaft
One of three identical drive modules. Motor centre X = axle +749.933; Z875; axle Z725.
INPUT SHAFT SECTION · Y AXIS · SCHEMATIC PROFILES / DIMENSIONED STATIONS
FLANGE PLATE: 350 × 390 × 20; pilot Ø200; 8 × Ø17.5 on265PCD
Feet: 70 ×160 ×16, each 2 ×Ø18 at100 centres; four M16 fasteners total
Cross-tie sleeves: Ø24 / Ø18 ×80; triangular gussets 12 thick,130 rise ×176 run
Input key18 ×11 ×70; axle key32 ×18 ×70; retain 21/49 duplex reduction
Spline teeth, machining fits, fastener grade, axial retention and bearing setting remain held.
Motor weight → flange plate → gussets/feet → carrier. Motor shaft carries torque, not chain pull.
LT14 · mm unless noted · Development dimensions · Do not scale · Not released for fabrication
